concept.title: People with health conditions or injuries
concept.shortdesc: People living with, or recovering from, long-term, neurological, stroke, brain injury or other health problems.

conbody.note: Draft group. Groups are a convenience for browsing the draft: the hierarchy was proposed by a second clustering pass and named by a language model, and no person has reviewed it.

ul.li: : People who have had a stroke, TIA or brain injury, with some nearby phrases about communication difficulties.
: People getting back to health after an injury, surgery, illness or hospital stay, including rehabilitation after discharge.
: People living with ongoing or unspecified health conditions, including those with complex health needs.
: People living with a named or general neurological condition such as Parkinson's, motor neurone disease, Huntington's or functional neurological disorder.
